text:
maggie: Heads up — PR #1284 ready for merge once we resolve a couple small things. Quick context: renamed CacheKey -> CacheHandle, and split out batch_size default. Ran ruff/gofmt and fixed formatting but CI shows two lint failures and mypy complaint.
ryan: I can take a look later today. Which files need attention?
maggie: Mostly eng/runtime/cache.py and eng/runtime/serve.py. Lint failures are unused-import and line-length in cache.py. mypy complains about Optional[str] vs str in handle id.
anya: I left a comment on the PR about the rename — rename looks good, but can we add a brief migration note in release_notes? also unit test for cache key equality maybe?
maggie: :thumbsup: added test, pushed. The migration note draft is here: https://docs.internal/release-notes/1284 — thoughts?
samir: I'll run CI locally. If it's just an unused import my IDE removed it earlier; could be leftover. If mypy fails, add cast or tighten typing.
ci-bot: CI update: build #4521 failed: ruff checks failed in eng/runtime/cache.py (lines 34, 78). mypy check failed in eng/runtime/serve.py:481
ryan: On it. Quick Q: did rename change external API surfaces? If so, we should feature-flag.
maggie: No external API changes — internal only. But added a deprecated alias in __init__ to be safe.
olivia: Quick nit: prefer snake_case for new var 'CacheHandleID' — should be 'cache_handle_id' per style. Also trailing comma in the test file.
maggie: Thanks — fixed snake_case & trailing comma. Pushed commit 2.
ci-bot: CI update: build #4523 running...
ci-bot: CI update: build #4523 passed all checks. Tests: 324 passed. ruff: OK. mypy: OK.
ryan: LGTM. Approving now.
anya: Approved. Please merge during merge window (tomorrow 10:00-12:00 PT) to avoid heavy traffic.
maggie: Will merge tomorrow at 10:05 PT then. Thanks everyone :rocket:
